title: Minimum Distance Excluding One Maximum Weighted Edge
summary: In a connected simple undirected graph with positive edge weights, price a path by its edge-weight sum minus one maximum-weight edge. If the maximum repeats, subtract it only once. Return the minimum such cost from node zero to node n-1.
